description: Tote helps you find and use the things you saved. Search your Totes, read their details, and browse your lists from ChatGPT. Ask to show a Tote for a compact detail card with its available content and source links. With write access, you can rename Totes, update private notes, edit supported details, and organize lists. Tote respects the connected account’s access and preview limits. A Tote account is required.

defaultPrompt: Show the details of a Tote from my saved places.
Show the Totes in my Weekend list.
